name: DoctorHealthy1
mission: Making evidence-based health guidance accessible to everyone
vision: A world where personalized health optimization is available to all

colors.usage: Use Health Blue for primary actions, Health Green for success states, Warning Yellow for attention needed

hierarchy.H1: Bold, 2.25rem - Page titles and main headings
hierarchy.Caption: Regular, 0.875rem - Secondary text

components.Health Cards: Rounded corners (12px), subtle shadows, primary color accents
components.Buttons: Rounded (10px), clear hierarchy with primary/secondary styles
components.Forms: Clean, accessible, with clear validation states

accessibility.Focus States: Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
accessibility.Screen Readers: Proper ARIA labels and semantic HTML
